properties.NAME: Quapaw Indian Res.
properties.CHANGE: The Quapaw Indian Reserve was left outside the boundaries of any county. The reserve was created 24 Aug 1818 when the Quapaws ceded their claim to other lands south of the Arkansas River.
properties.CITATION: (Mo. Terr. Laws 1818-1819, ch. 232a, secs. 1-3/pp. 589-591; Hanson and Moneyhon, 19-20)
